Andhra CM Naidu Seeks Centre's Support for River Linking Project

Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu has requested support from the central government to secure the state's water future, specifically urging Prime Minister Narendra Modi to prioritize the Godavari-Cauvery river linking project. Naidu also sought aid for the 2027 Pushkarams festival. The Chief Minister's focus is on ensuring water availability for Andhra Pradesh.
